1249.title: Dragon spear
1249.intro: The dragon spear is a two-handed melee weapon that requires level 60 Attack to wield. It does not require the completion of a quest to equip. Like most spears , it can be poisoned .
acquisition: The spear is a rare drop from both the rare and gem drop tables . On the gem drop table, the spear will only drop if the Legends' Quest has been completed, otherwise a talisman will be dropped in its place. However, the rare drop table does not require the quest's completion in order to be able to receive it as a drop. Wearing a ring of wealth will increase the chances of receiving one from both tables.

Goraks fought in the Gorak Plane while wearing a ring of wealth are more likely to drop the dragon spear than any other monster, with a drop rate of 1 in 325. Brutal black dragons are also frequent droppers of dragon spears, dropping it directly with a drop rate of 1 in 512 (while also having access to the rare drop table so they drop it slightly more common than this overall).

In addition to the sources in the above table, a Dragon spear can be obtained as a drop from the Rare drop table , accessible by most Slayer monsters. Goraks also drop Dragon spears at a rate of 1/325 with a ring of wealth equipped.

2366.title: Shield left half
2366.intro: The shield left half is an item that can be joined with the right half to create the dragon square shield with level 60 Smithing . Joining the right half with the left half nets 75 Smithing experience. The other half of the shield is sold by Siegfried Erkle in the Legends Guild Shop of Useful Items for 750,000 coins.
acquisition: This item is a rare drop from the rare drop table . Wearing a ring of wealth will increase the chances of receiving one from the rare drop table. Goraks fought in the Gorak Plane are likely droppers of the shield left half, with a drop rate of 1/243.75 (with a ring of wealth equipped) if Fairytale II - Cure a Queen and Legends' Quest have been completed.
Skotizo is the monster most likely to drop the shield left half, with a drop rate of 1/100, and is the only monster to have it on its standard drop table.

In addition to the sources in the above table, a Shield left half can be obtained as a drop from the Rare drop table , accessible by most Slayer monsters. Goraks also drop Shield left halves at a 1/244 chance with a ring of wealth equipped.

2996.title: Agility arena ticket (discontinued)
2996.intro: Agility arena tickets were earned from tagging ticket dispensers within the Brimhaven Agility Arena minigame. Each ticket was rewarded after tagging more than one dispenser in a row. Tickets could then be redeemed for Agility experience and rewards from the Brimhaven Agility Arena Ticket Exchange run by Pirate Jackie the Fruit .

tables.heading: Rewards
headers: Base (total) experience with Karamja gloves 2 , 3 or 4

acquisition: Agility arena tickets were earned from tagging ticket dispensers within the Brimhaven Agility Arena minigame. Each ticket was rewarded after tagging more than one dispenser in a row. Tickets could then be redeemed for Agility experience and rewards from the Brimhaven Agility Arena Ticket Exchange run by Pirate Jackie the Fruit .

Exchanging larger amounts of tickets for Agility experience offered experience bonuses, up to 33% more per ticket. Wearing Karamja Gloves 2 or higher from completing the medium Karamja Diary when exchanging tickets rewarded 10% more total experience. Completing the elite Karamja Diary rewarded a 10% chance of receiving double tickets when tagging a pillar. The experience rewards increased by 5 per ticket for each Agility level above 40.

The item was discontinued and a new version was introduced following the 9 May 2024 Project Rebalance update , which can only be redeemed for Agility experience at a flat rate, as well as introduced Brimhaven vouchers , which can be exchanged for items. The discontinued tickets, as well as the former shop, are still available in-game for players who have the discontinued tickets to redeem. Players can also exchange the discontinued tickets for Brimhaven vouchers by using the ticket on Pirate Jackie the Fruit.
There is now a 10% chance to receive double tickets in the Brimhaven Agility Arena after completing the elite Karamja Diary.

3140.title: Dragon chainbody
3140.intro: The dragon chainbody is the highest tier of chainbody in the game, requiring a Defence level of 60 to equip. As with most dragon armour , players cannot make this item using the Smithing skill.

3470.title: Fine cloth
3470.intro: Fine cloth is a material used in the making of splitbark armour . The armour can be made by either providing payment and materials to Wizard Jalarast in the Wizards' Tower , or through the Crafting skill. Fine cloth can be obtained in the Shades of Mort'ton minigame from any level of chest other than bronze, but the higher level chests have a better chance of acquiring it.

4151.title: Abyssal whip
4151.intro: The abyssal whip is a one-handed melee weapon which requires an Attack level of 70 to wield. It can be obtained as a drop from abyssal demons or from sacrificing an unsired .
acquisition: The abyssal whip is a one-handed melee weapon which requires an Attack level of 70 to wield. It can be obtained as a drop from abyssal demons or from sacrificing an unsired .

While still less powerful than other weapons such as the Ghrazi rapier and blade of Saeldor , the whip is still very popular among players for its simplicity and cost. It is a good training weapon for those wishing to increase their Attack or Defence , but not Strength , as the "Lash" option only provides shared experience between all three styles. Though it falls off compared to other weapons when they are obtained, holding a whip is recommended for the purpose of Master Treasure Trails , in which two potential steps require a whip.

The abyssal whip has a special attack , Energy Drain , which consumes 50% of the player's special attack energy, increases accuracy by 25%, and in PvP , transfers 10% of the target's run energy to the wielder. The target player will receive the message, "You feel drained!" in their chat window. The accuracy roll for Energy Drain is made against an opponent's slash defence.

Furthermore, using a Shattered relics variety ornament kit on an abyssal whip will change its appearance into that of an abyssal whip (or) . Players can also use either a volcanic or frozen whip mix , obtained from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing to cosmetically enhance the abyssal whip, creating a volcanic abyssal whip or a frozen abyssal whip , respectively. This only alters its appearance, and causes the whip to become untradeable. It can be reverted by using a cleaning cloth on the whip, but the mix will not be returned.

acquisition: Players can use an ornate maul handle to enhance the granite maul into a granite maul (ornate handle) , which reduces its special attack cost from 60% to 50%.
The granite clamp and ornate handle are obtained from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing .
The special attack cost was increased to 60%, though players can use an ornate maul handle on the granite maul to reduce the cost back to 50%.
The item was added to the game cache, but was unobtainable.

4207.title: Crystal weapon seed
4207.intro: A crystal weapon seed is an elven crystal that can be turned into crystal weapons . Completing the Gauntlet will yield a chance of gaining these seeds. The crystal weapon seed can be bought from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing for 12 Last Man Standing points.
acquisition: A crystal weapon seed is an elven crystal that can be turned into crystal weapons . Completing the Gauntlet will yield a chance of gaining these seeds. The crystal weapon seed can be bought from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing for 12 Last Man Standing points.

This seed can be restored into a crystal bow , a crystal shield , or a crystal halberd , the latter only with completion of the Hard Western Provinces Diary . Before completion of Song of the Elves , Ilfeen is the only one to offer this service to the player. She can be found at either of two clearings in Isafdar , teleporting between them periodically. If the player is mid-quest, and she is occupied with the fight against Lord Iorwerth , an Elven Scout will fulfil her role. After completion of the quest, Ilfeen is found in Prifddinas , slightly south of the house portal.

Players can also exchange the weapon seed for 10 crystal shards by speaking to Amrod in Prifddinas ' Hefin Inn . The seed can additionally be traded to Pennant in Prifddinas for one crystal acorn , which can be grown into a crystal tree that yields up to 28-32 crystal shards when harvested.

If the player has a crystal weapon seed, Ilfeen can enchant it into a crystal bow , shield , or halberd for coins. Having her sing halberds requires completion of the Hard Western Provinces Diary . Ilfeen cannot "recharge" the crystal items themselves, players must manually revert their item to a crystal weapon seed and choose the item that they want to pay her for. While singing yourself with shards always costs 855,183 coins , the price she charges depends on how many times she has previously been paid to enchant weapon seeds, down to a minimum price.

Equipment received from the Barrows reward chest is fully repaired and can be used for 15 hours of combat until it degrades completely and requires repair before it can be used again. Barrows armour degrades even if the player is using protection prayers or not taking damage. Barrows equipment does not suffer in performance as it degrades from fully repaired to fully degraded. Fully repaired Barrows items start out with no numbers in their names, e.g. Verac's plateskirt . It will become Verac's plateskirt 100 the first time it's used in combat. Eventually it will degrade to Verac's plateskirt 75 , then 50 , then 25 and finally 0 at which point the eq

When dropped or lost on dangerous PvP death, any piece of Barrows equipment will automatically degrade to 0 . Players who attempt to drop Barrows equipment will receive a warning message about this. As a bank note , dropping will not break the equipment.

There are two ways to repair Barrows equipment. Players can talk to any of the NPCs listed below and they will repair the items for a price, or repair the pieces themselves using an armour stand in any player-owned house . The equipment can be repaired at any stage, and the cost will be adjusted according to how much it has degraded. The repair costs below are as if the equipment has fully degraded.

acquisition: The fire cape is a melee cape obtained as a reward for completing the TzHaar Fight Cave . It is the second best melee cape in the game, outclassed only by the infernal cape . In order to obtain the fire cape, players must survive all waves of TzHaar Fight Caves and defeat TzTok-Jad . Note that the cape will not be awarded should both the player and TzTok-Jad die simultaneously, even though the boss log will count the kill. The player must be taken out of the cave by the game recognising TzTok-Jad's death; if they are removed from the cave due to dying, the game considers the player to have failed the challenge.
When worn, players are granted the fiery attribute and will therefore receive additional damage in PvP from the special effects of Pearl bolts (e) and Pearl dragon bolts (e) .

The fire cape is very popular for many forms of melee combat and is often the cape of choice, only surpassed by the infernal cape . In certain scenarios, other capes may be preferred for their higher accuracy bonuses, higher Prayer bonus, or for being easier to obtain or replace.

Players who don't want their cape can sell it to TzHaar-Mej-Jal for their choice of a 1/200 chance of obtaining the TzRek-Jad pet or a guaranteed 8,000 Tokkul . A lost fire cape can only be replaced by surviving the Fight Caves again to receive another one.

Players who have completed the Falador hard achievement diary will receive mole claws and mole skins from the Giant Mole in noted form. Like the mole skins, mole claws can be traded to Wyson the gardener for bird nests .
Unlike nests received through Woodcutting , Bird house trapping or Managing Miscellania , these nests never contain bird's eggs but often contain allotment and herb seeds .

Wyson the gardener will exchange mole claws and mole skins for nests at the rate of 1 nest per claw or skin. He will reward a unique variant of seed nest that contains different seeds than the woodcutting variant, as well as ring nests and empty nests . Wyson will accept noted claws and skins, and will provide nest boxes if the inventory is too full to hold all the nests.
The nests you receive when trading mole claws and skins to Wyson the gardener now provide you with more valuable seeds.

7980.title: Kbd heads
7980.intro: Kbd heads are a rare drop from the King Black Dragon . It can be stuffed at the Taxidermist in Canifis by using the item on her and paying 50,000 coins, returning a stuffed kbd heads . When players take it to the her, she will tell players "Three?! This must be a King Black Dragon! I'll have to get out my heavy duty tools -- this skin's as tough as iron!"
acquisition: Alternatively, the head can be sacrificed to the Dark Altar north of Arceuus , granting 2,500 Prayer experience. However, players with level 90 Magic can instead opt to use a knife on the heads to obtain three ensouled dragon heads , which will give a total of 4,680 Prayer experience by casting Master Reanimation on each of the heads.

The head can also be combined with a slayer helmet (or imbued) to create a black slayer helmet ; doing so requires purchasing the ability King Black Bonnet for 1,000 Slayer reward points . After claiming the hard tier rewards from the Combat Achievements system, the heads can additionally be combined with the dragon hunter crossbow to create a black variant .

7981.title: Kq head

acquisition: Lastly, the head can be combined with a slayer helmet or slayer helmet (i) to create a green slayer helmet or green slayer helmet (i) , respectively. Doing so requires purchasing the ability Kalphite Khat for 1,000 Slayer reward points .

8844.title: Bronze defender

8845.title: Iron defender

It is one of the two defenders that does not provide a strength bonus , along with the bronze defender.

8850.title: Rune defender
8850.intro: The rune defender is the 3rd strongest defender . It is used for its attack bonus and is held in the off-hand in place of a shield . It requires 40 Attack and 40 Defence to wield. The rune defender is dropped by cyclopes on the top floor of the Warriors' Guild after showing an adamant defender or better to Kamfreena as the player enters the room.
acquisition: The defender is popular among players of higher combat levels due to its offensive stats. It can be considered to be the third best off-hand item for melee training, only beaten by the dragon defender and Avernic defender , and is commonly used in PvP situations as re-obtaining a rune defender is easier than re-obtaining a dragon or Avernic one.

Players can attach a Rune defender ornament kit , obtained from hard Treasure Trails , to create a Rune defender (t) . This is only cosmetic, and does not affect the defender's stat bonuses. It can be dismantled, returning the defender and ornament kit.

8901.title: Black mask
8901.intro: The black mask is a unique mask worn in the head slot. The mask has the same stats as a black med helm . It provides a player 16.67% Attack and Strength boost against all monsters on the player's current Slayer task . It requires 20 Strength, 10 Defence , and 40 Combat to equip.
acquisition: For 1,250,000 Nightmare Zone points or 625,000 with the hard tier of Combat Achievements , 500 Soul Wars Zeal Tokens , or a scroll of imbuing purchased for 200 PvP Arena points , players can imbue a black mask, making it into a black mask (i) , which provides a 15% Ranged and Magic accuracy and damage boost in addition to its melee boost. Imbuing a charged black mask gives an imbued version with the same number of charges, though the imbued version loses charges similarly to the unimbued mask.

Players with 55 Crafting (boostable) and who have unlocked the Malevolent Masquerade ability from any Slayer Master for 400 Slayer reward points can combine a black mask with other items of Slayer headgear to make a slayer helmet . Note that this causes the mask to lose all of its charges.

acquisition: Rum can be purchased from Honest Jimmy at Trouble Brewing , at a cost of 20 pieces of eight . It serves as a single-use teleport back to Trouble Brewing. One sweetgrub and one scrapey tree bark are needed per bottle of rum.

10547.title: Healer hat
10547.intro: The healer hat is a possible reward item from Barbarian Assault and requires 45 Defence to wear. Players who have killed the Penance Queen and have 275 Honour points in each of the four roles can purchase the hat from Commander Connad , located on the main floor of the Barbarian Outpost . The hat is part of the penance set , all parts of which are available from Barbarian Assault.
acquisition: The healer hat is a possible reward item from Barbarian Assault and requires 45 Defence to wear. The hat is part of the penance set , all parts of which are available from Barbarian Assault.

Its stats are very similar to the farseer helm . Both require 45 Defence and offer +6 magic attack bonus with attack penalties of -5 to all other styles. However, the healer hat has a slightly higher (+1) magic defence bonus at the cost of lower melee defence (-2 to stab, slash, and crush).
Barbarian Assault was enabled, making the healer hat obtainable.
This content was included when the Old School RuneScape servers officially launched, but was unobtainable as Barbarian Assault was disabled.

10548.title: Fighter hat
10548.intro: The fighter hat is a piece of members-only armour that requires 45 Defence to wear, and is obtained through the Barbarian Assault minigame . Players with 275 honour points in each role and who have killed the Penance Queen can purchase the hat from Commander Connad , located on the ground floor of the Barbarian Outpost .
acquisition: The fighter hat is a piece of members-only armour that requires 45 Defence to wear, and is obtained through the Barbarian Assault minigame . Players with 275 honour points in each role and who have killed the Penance Queen can purchase the hat from Commander Connad , located on the ground floor of the Barbarian Outpost .

The fighter hat is sometimes used in place of the warrior helm and berserker helm . The warrior helm provides slightly better defensive bonuses, but offers an attack bonus to slash only, while the fighter hat also provides attack bonuses to stab and crush . In fact, the +5 stab attack bonus makes the fighter hat the best-in-slot item for stab attack. The berserker helm has slightly better defensive bonuses and provides a strength bonus (+3), but provides no melee attack bonuses. The fighter hat is a popular choice among obsidian maulers that are unable to obtain the Inquisitor's great helm .
Barbarian Assault was enabled, making the fighter hat obtainable.
This content was included when the Old School RuneScape servers officially launched, but was unobtainable as Barbarian Assault was disabled.

10551.title: Fighter torso
10551.intro: The fighter torso (called the Penance torso in the Barbarian Assault Reward Shop ) is armour that requires 40 Defence to equip and is a reward from the Barbarian Assault minigame . It can be purchased from Commander Connad for 375 honour points in all four roles, and one Penance Queen kill. It can be sold back to Connad for 300 honour points in all four roles by using it on him.
acquisition: The fighter torso (called the Penance torso in the Barbarian Assault Reward Shop ) is armour that requires 40 Defence to equip and is a reward from the Barbarian Assault minigame . It can be sold back to Connad for 300 honour points in all four roles by using it on him.

The fighter torso is one of the most popular and frequently used armour pieces for melee training , where maximizing damage output via strength bonus outweighs the benefit of any other equipment bonus. Its strength bonus is tied with the oathplate chest , Bandos chestplate , Blood Moon chestplate , and Inquisitor's hauberk but only costs time playing Barbarian Assault instead of coins. Its defence bonuses sit in between that of the adamant and rune platebodies , except for its slash defence bonus which is higher than the rune platebody and even the granite body .
The fighter torso is the item Falo requires players to show him when he sings about: Penance healers runners and more, obtaining this body often gives much deplore.

These logs can be bought on the Grand Exchange for 90,400 . It is also dropped by undead lumberjacks in the Temple Trekking minigame . It increases experience by 0.4% when Woodcutting . This is increased to +2.5% when wearing the whole set. It is the only piece of the lumberjack outfit that counts as warm clothing when fighting the Wintertodt .

This item can be stored in the armour case of a costume room , as part of the Lumberjack Costume set. Ultimate Ironmen will be unable to retrieve individual pieces until the full set is stored. It can also be stored in the Forestry kit with a Clothes pouch in order to receive the outfit's benefits without having to wear them. However, bonuses from other outfits, such as the graceful outfit , will override the clothes pouch if worn.

10976.title: Long bone
10976.intro: A long bone is a drop from various monsters , typically those that also drop big bones , at a nearly universal rate of 1/400.
acquisition: The crazy and deranged archaeologists have a considerably higher chance of dropping a long bone.

The Carpenter's outfit set effect does not apply to the Construction experience rewarded. Barlak will automatically take all of your long bones, including those in your bank, so it is not necessary to have any bones in your inventory.

10977.title: Curved bone
10977.intro: A curved bone is an item dropped by any monster that drops big bones or giant bones , as well as Venenatis and Sotetseg . Curved bones are dropped at a universal rate of 1/5,012.5.
acquisition: As comparison - if you were to gain the 6,750 experience with oak planks , it would cost 58,275 coins . This can be considered as an extra theoretical value of a curved bone.

11037.title: Brine sabre
11037.intro: The brine sabre is a one-handed weapon that requires 40 Attack to wield. It is dropped by brine rats in the small cave accessed during Olaf's Quest . The brine sabre is a slightly better alternative to a rune scimitar , boasting 2 higher strength and slash attack bonuses when compared to the former. However, it is significantly more expensive due to the fact it is only dropped by the rarely-killed brine rat at a low rate.

11235.title: Dark bow
11235.intro: The dark bow is a two-handed ranged weapon that requires level 60 in Ranged to wield. It can only be obtained as a drop from dark beasts and their superior variant, night beasts . With an attack speed of 9 (5.4 seconds), and 8 on rapid (4.8 seconds), this bow stands out as the slowest weapon in the game. It fires two arrows per attack which roll independent accuracy checks. It has the maximum possible attack range of 10, so th
acquisition: The dark bow is a two-handed ranged weapon that requires level 60 in Ranged to wield. It can only be obtained as a drop from dark beasts and their superior variant, night beasts . With an attack speed of 9 (5.4 seconds), and 8 on rapid (4.8 seconds), this bow stands out as the slowest weapon in the game. It fires two arrows per attack which roll independent accuracy checks. It has the maximum possible attack range of 10, so the longrange attack style will not increase its attack range.

Players can use dark bow paint , purchased from the Last Man Standing shop for 25 points, to recolour a dark bow. This process makes the bow untradeable. To remove the colouring and make it tradeable again, players must use a cleaning cloth on the bow to return to its regular state (the paint will be lost).

11286.title: Draconic visage
11286.intro: The draconic visage is a very rare item obtained from many high-levelled dragons , as well as Skeletal Wyverns . It was supposedly created by the Dragonkin as a way to channel dragonfire .
acquisition: The draconic visage is a very rare item obtained from many high-levelled dragons , as well as Skeletal Wyverns . It was supposedly created by the Dragonkin as a way to channel dragonfire .

11335.title: Dragon full helm
11335.intro: The dragon full helm is a helmet that requires 60 Defence to equip. The dragon full helm gives better defence bonuses than its medium helm counterpart. Due to its high price, and lack of prayer or strength bonuses, it is more often used as a sign of wealth, rather than in combat.
acquisition: The only way to obtain the dragon full helm is by killing mithril dragons in the Ancient Cavern . The helm can be received from mithril dragons directly as a very rare drop, or from a barbarian spirit after lighting a pyre ship with chewed bones also obtained from mithril dragons.

The drop rate of a dragon full helm from mithril dragons directly is 1/32,768 while the drop rate from chewed bones is 1/256. Chewed bones themselves can only be obtained from mithril dragons as an uncommon drop with a drop rate of 3/128.
Combining both the drop rate from chewed bones and the drop rate of the helm itself, the effective drop rate of the dragon full helm from a mithril dragon is 1/8,192.

The dragon full helm was originally intended to release alongside The Fremennik Isles , but it was cut before release for unknown reasons. Despite this, its models remained unused in the game files, referred to as " fris_dragonhelm ". Like the dragon sq shield , it would have been obtained in halves which would have to be combined in some way.

11338.title: Chewed bones
11338.intro: Chewed bones are obtained exclusively as a drop from mithril dragons in the Ancient Cavern at a rate of 3/128. No other monsters in the Ancient Cavern will drop chewed bones, and looting the skeletons won't give chewed bones either (only mangled bones ). The bones can be burnt on a pyre ship for rewards, including the dragon full helm .
acquisition: Chewed bones are obtained exclusively as a drop from mithril dragons in the Ancient Cavern at a rate of 3/128. No other monsters in the Ancient Cavern will drop chewed bones, and looting the skeletons won't give chewed bones either (only mangled bones ). The bones can be burnt on a pyre ship for rewards, including the dragon full helm .

When these bones are put on a pyre ship and burnt (requires a tinderbox , axe , and any type of log excluding blisterwood, jatoba, and pyre logs), they will summon a peaceful barbarian spirit , who will reward the player with various items. These items include the dragon full helm , various potions , runes , or projectile ammunition. Players may kill mithril dragons in the hopes of obtaining a dragon full helm drop; if unsuccessful, they can take any gained chewed bones to be burned in a pyre ship for another chance at gaining a dragon full helm. Note that using higher-level logs does not increase chances of receiving a dragon full helm.

Burning chewed bones via a pyre ship provides a 3x experience bonus to the next few bones buried, including those buried by the bonecrusher , with the amount varying by which logs are burnt. The player will receive a message saying, You gain extra prayer experience as the ancestral barbarian spirits watch over you. This bonus accumulates and is not lost upon death. A player can have a maximum of 200 stored instances of 3x experience from burning chewed bones before they won't receive any more. The bonus does not apply when burying the bones from the Hopespear's Will miniquest, nor does it apply to giant bones and bull bones .
The following drop rates are provided by Jagex, unless otherwise specified.

11341.title: Ancient page
11341.intro: Ancient pages are pages found within the Ancient Cavern that can be added to My notes . This can be done even without the book in the player's inventory by using the 'Copy to log' action on the page. Ancient pages are lost on death and cannot be recovered from a gravestone.
acquisition: There are 26 different pages that can be found. Rummaging skeletons gives a 1/13 chance of receiving an ancient page, while the spirits and skeletons have a 5/128 (1/25.6) chance of dropping them. In addition, mithril dragons have a 1/64 chance of dropping them. Brutal green dragons do not drop the pages.

Because they are fairly uncommon drops, and duplicate pages can be obtained, My notes can take several hours to complete. One possible strategy for collecting them is to rummage each of the three skeletons found in the Ancient Cavern and then hop worlds .

acquisition: The Void mage helm is a piece of Void Knight equipment . It can be bought from a Void Knight for 200 commendation points , if the player has at least 42 Attack , Strength , Defence , Hitpoints , Ranged , and Magic , and 22 Prayer to buy and wear one. It is worn in combination with the other pieces of Void Knight Armour ( Void knight top , Void knight robe , and Void knight gloves ) to achieve the designated set effect. The repair cost of the Void mage helm has been increased from 40,000 to 160,000 coins .

11666.intro: The Void seal is a piece of Void Knight equipment reward in the Pest Control activity. It can be bought from a Void Knight for 10 commendation points. Unlike the rest of the Void Knight equipment, players do not require at least 42 Attack , Strength , Defence , Hitpoints , along with 22 Prayer to buy and wear one. This item is worn in the neck slot . The seal will inflict 8-12 Hitpoints of damage upon nearby Pests when the pla
acquisition: The Void seal is a piece of Void Knight equipment reward in the Pest Control activity. It can be bought from a Void Knight for 10 commendation points. Unlike the rest of the Void Knight equipment, players do not require at least 42 Attack , Strength , Defence , Hitpoints , along with 22 Prayer to buy and wear one. This item is worn in the neck slot . The seal will inflict 8-12 Hitpoints of damage upon nearby Pests when the player rubs it. The seal has eight charges. Once its 8 charges are used, it dissolves. It can only be utilised in Pest Control games, and is useless in normal combat except for its slight defensive bonuses.

Due to the void seal's limited uses and the fact that it gives no experience, it is very rarely purchased. Aside from this, activating the seal does not provide any boost in the player's activity bar.

11785.title: Armadyl crossbow
11785.intro: The Armadyl crossbow is a ranging weapon that requires a Ranged level of 70 to wield, and can fire up to and including dragon bolts . It is dropped only by Commander Zilyana . This item counts as an Armadyl item in the God Wars Dungeon .
acquisition: The Armadyl crossbow has a special attack , Armadyl Eye , which consumes 50% of the player's special attack energy. Armadyl Eye will, for one shot, double the player's overall accuracy (level + gear accuracy), as well as doubling the base chance of an enchanted bolt 's special effect to occur.

For example, when performing the special attack with enchanted diamond bolts , the bolt's special effect, Armour Piercing , would have a 20% chance of activating instead of 10%. If the Hard Kandarin Diary has been completed, the additional chance given from the diary reward is added after doubling, meaning the chance of activating for that shot is increased from 10% to a total of 21%.
The special attack of the Armadyl crossbow has received a graphical rework.

11787.title: Steam battlestaff
11787.intro: A steam battlestaff is a steam elemental staff which provides unlimited amounts of water and fire runes as well as the autocast option when equipped. It requires 30 Attack and 30 Magic to wield.
acquisition: The mystic steam staff is an even stronger alternative, providing better melee and magic stat bonuses. It is obtained by taking the steam battlestaff and 40,000 to Thormac . (Reduced to 30,000 or 20,000 with completion of the hard and elite Kandarin diaries respectively.)
The staff is only obtainable as a potential drop from K'ril Tsutsaroth .

Players can use a steam staff upgrade kit , obtained from Justine's stuff for the Last Shopper Standing , to cosmetically enhance their steam battlestaff, creating a steam battlestaff (or) . This only alters its appearance, and becomes untradeable. It can be reverted, but the kit will not be retained.

11791.title: Staff of the Dead
11791.intro: The staff of the dead is a one-handed bladed staff that requires 75 Magic and 75 Attack to wield. It is dropped by K'ril Tsutsaroth , and counts as a Zamorakian item while in the God Wars Dungeon and in the desert Bandit Camp . It is one of several one-handed staves which boost magic damage by 15%.
acquisition: When a combat spell is cast with the staff, there is a 1/7 (~14.2%) chance that the staff will negate the rune cost for that spell.

In response to player requests for a magic weapon with the same functionality as the 2010 version of the staff of light from RuneScape , the weapon was offered as a new reward from K'ril Tsutsaroth in a Developer's Blog offering the God Wars Dungeon . The weapon passed the poll with 78% of the supporting votes.

11810.title: Armadyl hilt
11810.intro: The Armadyl hilt is a rare drop from Kree'arra , in the God Wars Dungeon . Its design resembles a bird or winged being. When attached to a completed Godsword blade , which can be created by combining the three Godsword shards, it creates the Armadyl godsword .

11812.title: Bandos hilt
11812.intro: The Bandos hilt is dropped by General Graardor , in the God Wars Dungeon . When attached to a completed Godsword blade , it creates the Bandos godsword .

11814.title: Saradomin hilt
11814.intro: The Saradomin hilt is a rare drop from Commander Zilyana , in the God Wars Dungeon . When attached to a completed Godsword blade , which can be created by combining the three Godsword shards , it creates the Saradomin Godsword .

11816.title: Zamorak hilt
11816.intro: The Zamorak hilt is dropped by K'ril Tsutsaroth , in the God Wars Dungeon as a rare drop. When attached to a completed godsword blade , which can be created by combining the three godsword blade shards, it creates the Zamorak godsword .

acquisition: If killing a boss and their three minions, the effective drop rate of a godsword shard 1 is 1/304.8.

acquisition: The Zamorakian spear is a two-handed spear obtained from the God Wars Dungeon as a drop from K'ril Tsutsaroth and his bodyguards, requiring an Attack level of 70 to wield. Unlike other spears , it cannot be poisoned , and has its highest bonus in stab , while other spears have the same bonus on all melee attack styles. 11832.title: Bandos chestplate
11832.intro: The Bandos chestplate is a part of the Bandos armour set, which requires 65 Defence to wear. It is dropped by General Graardor and his bodyguards in the God Wars Dungeon . The Bandos chestplate provides a +4 Strength bonus , and more defensive bonuses than comparable body armours such as the fighter torso and Inquisitor's hauberk . Despite seemingly being made of metal, the Bandos chestplate does not interfere with Ava's devic
acquisition: The Torva platebody is a direct upgrade, providing higher Strength and defensive bonuses. The Bandos chestplate nevertheless has continued relevance as both a lower-cost alternative and a source of Bandosian components , which are used to repair damaged Torva armour .

11834.title: Bandos tassets
11834.intro: Bandos tassets are a part of the Bandos armour set, requiring 65 Defence to wear. They are dropped by General Graardor and his bodyguards in the God Wars Dungeon . Bandos tassets are widely used by experienced players as they offer high stats compared to other leg slot items, including the second highest strength bonus, tied with the Inquisitor's plateskirt , Blood Moon tassets , and oathplate legs . It's beaten only by Torva
acquisition: Compared to the Torva platelegs, tassets have 2 less strength bonus, and 10 to 15 less defence bonuses for melee and ranged; however, Torva armour requires 80 Defence and is harder to obtain, making it cost significantly more.

The most comparable lower cost degradeable option is the Blood Moon tassets ; it offers the same strength bonus as the Bandos tassets, however instead of having high melee and ranged defence, it boasts the highest magic defence of any melee armour.

11836.title: Bandos boots
11836.intro: Bandos boots are part of the Bandos armour set, which requires 65 Defence to wear. They have the second highest ranged defence bonus for boots (beaten only by its upgraded variants, the guardian boots and the echo boots ).
acquisition: However, their high ranged defence bonus makes them desirable for players trying to maximise their defensive bonuses. They are occasionally seen being used by ranged tanks due to their low cost and substantial defence bonus. Furthermore, they are effective when combined with the rest of the Bandos armour when trying to achieve an extremely high ranged defence bonus.
The item has been removed from the Grand Exchange's item sink list .

11838.title: Saradomin sword
11838.intro: The Saradomin sword is the personal weapon of Commander Zilyana , the Saradominist general within the God Wars Dungeon . It can be obtained as a rare drop from Commander Zilyana, or as a very rare drop from her bodyguards. It is a two-handed sword which requires 70 Attack to wield.
acquisition: The Saradomin sword is the personal weapon of Commander Zilyana , the Saradominist general within the God Wars Dungeon . It can be obtained as a rare drop from Commander Zilyana, or as a very rare drop from her bodyguards. It is a two-handed sword which requires 70 Attack to wield.

The special attack rolls against the opponent's Slash defence bonus using the attack bonus of the stance the player is currently in. If the melee attack misses, then the Magic attack will also fail. Players receive 2 Magic experience for each point of damage caused by the extra Magic damage.

As several weapons of similar tier were later introduced into Old School RuneScape , the Saradomin sword has since fallen out of popularity as the "best" weapon for training Strength. However, the sword is still comparable in power to other level 70 weapons, especially when cost efficiency is taken into account.
The item has been removed from the Grand Exchange's item sink list .

11840.title: Dragon boots

acquisition: Dragon boots can be upgraded with a primordial crystal , obtained as a rare drop from Cerberus , to create a pair of primordial boots . Doing so requires level 60 Runecraft and Magic .

acquisition: Marks of Grace are a currency obtained while training Agility on certain Agility courses . They can be spent at Grace's Graceful Clothing for pieces of the graceful outfit and amylase , which is the secondary ingredient for creating stamina potions . In addition, marks can be exchanged with Osten in Shayzien to recolour pieces of the graceful outfit.
Higher level courses have a greater chance of spawning marks. Marks spawned are player-specific, meaning players are only able to see and pick up marks spawned for them and not for other players.

Marks of grace can also be obtained indirectly via the Brimhaven Agility Arena or Colossal Wyrm Agility Course , by exchanging Amylase packs with Grace at an exchange rate of 7.5 Brimhaven vouchers or 12.5 termites per 1 mark of grace.

Completing the easy, medium and hard Kandarin Diary increases the chance of receiving marks of grace during the Seers' Village Rooftop Course by rerolling for a mark after a failed spawn roll with a 5, 10, or 15 percent chance respectively. This translates to an effective 10, 20, or 30 percent increase to the base rate of spawning marks (1/3).

11902.intro: The leaf-bladed sword is one of three melee weapons used to harm turoths and kurasks , along with the leaf-bladed spear and battleaxe .

11905.title: Trident of the Seas
11905.intro: The trident of the seas is a one-handed powered staff requiring 75 Magic to wield. Once charged with runes and coins, it can be used to attack with a built-in magic spell regardless of the player’s current spellbook .

acquisition: To charge the trident, use the runes or coins on the trident. Assuming non-stop use (one cast every 2.4 seconds, 1,500 casts per hour), the trident costs 498,000 coins per hour to use.

Fully charging an uncharged staff costs 830,000 coins total: 2,500 death runes, 2,500 chaos runes, 12,500 fire runes, and 25,000 coins. Players can configure the charges while the weapon is in their bank by right-clicking on Configure-Charges, as long as players have the required materials.

Players with level 59 Crafting can attach a magic fang to the trident using a chisel , creating a trident of the swamp . In addition to a +10 magic attack bonus and a +3 bonus to the max hit, it also gains the ability to inflict venom on a target. However, the trident of the swamp requires using 1 Zulrah's scale (with a cost of 151 coins ) instead of just 10 coins for each charge.

The base maximum hit dealt by the trident is dependent on the player's current Magic level, starting at 20 with level 75 Magic and increasing by one every three Magic levels, up to a maximum of 36 at level 123+ (obtainable only through smelling salts in Tombs of Amascut ). Invisible boosts, such as from the trident's attack styles, do not affect the max hit. The trident always has a max hit of at least 1, even when reduced to 0 magic. 11920.title: Dragon pickaxe
11920.intro: The dragon pickaxe is the second strongest and second fastest pickaxe in-game, tied with the 3rd Age pickaxe and behind the crystal pickaxe . It requires 61 Mining to mine with the pickaxe and 60 Attack to wield it. However, as its special attack temporarily boosts the player's Mining level by 3, players with at least 60 Attack can start mining with the pickaxe at 58 Mining.
acquisition: This effect is useful to increase the chance of successful rolls or to meet a Mining level requirement above the player's base level. When used alongside the Lightbearer ring, special attack energy regenerates twice as fast, making it viable to consistently mine rocks 1-2 levels higher than base.

Note that any levels boosted above 99 with the special attack will be treated as 99. Therefore, you will start to receive diminishing returns with the special attack at level 97 and 98, with there being no value in using the special at level 99.

Broken dragon pickaxes can be obtained as a 1/100 drop from Volcanic Mine ore packs , and can be repaired back to a dragon pickaxe by speaking to Nurmof in the Dwarven Mine , for a fee of 2,500,000 coins .

11942.title: Ecumenical key
11942.intro: An ecumenical key is an item dropped by all monsters in the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon , east of the Forgotten Cemetery , which can be used to instantly access the boss room of any one of the five Godwars bosses ( General Graardor , Kree'arra , Commander Zilyana , K'ril Tsutsaroth , and Nex ) without having to obtain the kill count normally required.
acquisition: An ecumenical key is an item dropped by all monsters in the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon , east of the Forgotten Cemetery , which can be used to instantly access the boss room of any one of the five Godwars bosses ( General Graardor , Kree'arra , Commander Zilyana , K'ril Tsutsaroth , and Nex ) without having to obtain the kill count normally required.

Players are limited to having three (3) keys at a time; completing the Medium and Hard Wilderness Diary increases this limit to four (4) and five (5) keys , respectively. If players receive additional key drops, they will be unable to pick them up as they are deleted; a message appears in the player's chatbox stating, "You already have enough of these".

While all monsters within the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon can drop the ecumenical key, the fastest way to obtain keys is to kill lower-levelled monsters, such as imps , goblins , icefiends , and pyrefiends . Imps are the weakest, while ice and pyrefiends tend to fight Saradominist spiritual mages , Bandosian spiritual warriors , and orks frequently. The spiritual mages and warriors may also be killed if they are low on health, provided that the player possesses the appropriate Slayer level to do so.
The base drop rate of the ecumenical key is 1/60; the hard, elite, master, and grandmaster tier rewards from the Combat Achievements system increases this to 1/55, 1/50, 1/45, and 1/40 respectively.

12002.title: Occult necklace
12002.intro: The occult necklace is a magical amulet that requires 70 Magic to wear. It is dropped by the smoke devil and its boss variant . Wearing it increases the player's Magic damage by 5%, and is the only amulet to give such a bonus. This 5% bonus will also stack with existing boosts, such as the staff of the dead and the imbued slayer helmet . The salve amulet(ei) does not apply its damage bonus to other hit targets when barraging .
acquisition: Players can attach an occult ornament kit , obtained from master clue scrolls , to cosmetically enhance the necklace, creating an occult necklace (or) . This only alters its appearance, and gives no stat enhancements. It can be dismantled, returning the necklace and ornament kit.

acquisition: Zul-andra teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to Zul-Andra . They can be obtained from defeating Zulrah .

On release, Zul-andra teleports were dropped in quantities of 50 per drop which was shortly reduced to 20. This caused an oversupply of teleport scrolls, and the drop rate was silently reduced to one scroll per drop on 15 October 2015 , limiting the quantity of scrolls that enter the game economy. As a result the teleport scroll rapidly increased in price. This caused controversy within the Old School RuneScape community, as players who had hoarded teleport scrolls prior to the update were able to profit greatly due to the higher prices. On the day of the update, 9,092,122 scrolls were traded on the Grand Exchange .

13200.title: Tanzanite mutagen
13200.intro: A tanzanite mutagen is an untradeable item dropped by Zulrah . It allows a player to cosmetically recolour their serpentine helm to a turquoise coloured tanzanite helm . The mutagen is consumed upon use.
acquisition: The drop rate for this item is calculated from three different rolls: the chance of missing the unique drop table (255/256), the chance of rolling Zulrah's flax table (10/248) and the chance of rolling the mutagen table (20/5,264). Both mutagens are equally likely.

Thus, multiplying these three fractions will result in ~1/6,553, which is the chance of either mutagen per roll, or a ~1/13,106 chance for a specific mutagen. However, since Zulrah gives two rolls to its drop table per kill, the chances are roughly doubled, giving a ~1/3,277 chance for any mutagen or a ~1/6,553 chance for a specific mutagen.
The drop rate was slightly increased from ~1/6,580 due to crystal weapon seeds being removed from Zulrah's drop table.

13201.title: Magma mutagen
13201.intro: A magma mutagen is an untradeable item dropped by Zulrah . It allows a player to cosmetically recolour their serpentine helm to a magma helm . The mutagen is consumed upon use.
acquisition: The drop rate for this item is calculated from three different rolls: the chance of missing the unique drop table (255/256), the chance of rolling Zulrah's flax table (10/248) and the chance of rolling the mutagen table (20/5,264). Both mutagens are equally likely.

Thus, multiplying these three fractions will result in ~1/6,553, which is the chance of either mutagen per roll, or a ~1/13,106 chance for a specific mutagen. However, since Zulrah gives two rolls to its drop table per kill, the chances are roughly doubled, giving a ~1/3,277 chance for any mutagen or a ~1/6,553 chance for a specific mutagen.
The drop rate was slightly increased from ~1/6,580 due to crystal weapon seeds being removed from Zulrah's drop table.
The drop rate was slightly lowered from 1/6,553.9 per kill as crushed nests were removed from Zulrah's drop table, due to changes in how the drops are now rolled.

19677.title: Ancient shard
19677.intro: Ancient shards are obtained from monsters found within the Catacombs of Kourend (excluding ghosts ). Three shards can be used with a Darklight at the altar in the centre of the catacombs to create an Arclight , a degradeable variant of the darklight that is the second most powerful melee weapon when used against demons. Ancient shards are also used to charge Arclight. One shard provides 333 charges, three shards provide 1,000
acquisition: Ancient shards are obtained from monsters found within the Catacombs of Kourend (excluding ghosts ). Three shards can be used with a Darklight at the altar in the centre of the catacombs to create an Arclight , a degradeable variant of the darklight that is the second most powerful melee weapon when used against demons. Ancient shards are also used to charge Arclight. One shard provides 333 charges, three shards provide 1,000 charges; up to a maximum of 10,000. The most powerful melee weapon against demons, the Emberlight , requires a fully charged Arclight.

As the drop rate for ancient shards are based on the number of hitpoints a monster has, the best methods of obtaining them will require the player to consider time-to-kill versus drop rate. Attacking multiple monsters at once will give players faster shard rates, making multi-hit attacks such as Ice Barrage , black chinchompas , and the venator bow the best weapons for this method. Barraging and using chinchompas will be more active, whereas the venator bow allows for a more reclined experience.
In addition, when farming shards players can also obtain dark totem pieces which give access to Skotizo and by extension more shards due to his guaranteed drops.
The drop rate of ancient shards (excluding Skotizo ) is determined by the amount of hitpoints the monster has.

19685.title: Dark totem
19685.intro: The dark totem is an item that can be created by combining the dark totem base , dark totem middle , and dark totem top . The totem pieces are dropped in that order and duplicates drop after all three are obtained. It is used on the altar in the centre of the Catacombs of Kourend to access the lower level of the catacombs to fight Skotizo . The totem is consumed when using it on the altar regardless of the outcome of the fight
acquisition: The dark totem is an item that can be created by combining the dark totem base , dark totem middle , and dark totem top . The totem pieces are dropped in that order and duplicates drop after all three are obtained. It is used on the altar in the centre of the Catacombs of Kourend to access the lower level of the catacombs to fight Skotizo . The totem is consumed when using it on the altar regardless of the outcome of the fight.

All three components can be found by killing monsters (excluding ghosts) in the Catacombs of Kourend and in the Giants' Den . Superior slayer monsters have a 100% chance of dropping a totem piece; all others have a chance equal to 1 / ( 500 − H ) , where H is the monster's Hitpoints . Since the improvement in drop rate as monster HP increases is very small, dark totem pieces can be most quickly obtained by killing low HP monsters within the catacombs, such as hill giants .
A fully-assembled dark totem can also be rarely obtained from Skotizo .
Dark totem pieces no longer need to be assembled in order to continue receiving them.

19707.title: Amulet of eternal glory
19707.intro: The amulet of eternal glory is a special dragonstone amulet possessing identical stats and features of a regular amulet of glory , except it has unlimited teleport charges instead of the regular four or six maximum charges. However, it cannot be mounted in a player-owned house .

tables.heading: Recharging at the Fountain of Rune

rows.text: Per amulet recharged with fewer than six charges, after Heroes Quest

acquisition: It is made (only after completion of Heroes Quest) while charging amulets of glory (including the trimmed variant ) with fewer than six charges at the Fountain of Rune in the Wilderness . Each amulet recharged has a 1 in 25,000 chance to be turned into an amulet of eternal glory. When this occurs, a message in the chatbox will appear, stating: " The power of the fountain is transferred into an amulet of eternal glory. It will now have unlimited charges. "
As with the regular charged amulet of glory , it retains the passive effect which increases chance to mine gems and gem rocks .

20014.intro: The 3rd Age pickaxe is a piece of 3rd Age equipment . It requires 65 Attack to wield and 61 Mining to use and shares the same mining speed and special attack as a dragon pickaxe . It is widely understood as one of, if not the most valuable item in the game entirely due to rarity.
acquisition: This effect is useful to increase the chance of successful rolls or to meet a Mining level requirement above the player's base level. When used alongside the Lightbearer ring, special attack energy regenerates twice as fast, making it viable to consistently mine rocks 1-2 levels higher than base.

Note that any levels boosted above 99 with the special attack will be treated as 99. Therefore, you will start to receive diminishing returns with the special attack at level 97 and 98, with there being no value in using the special at level 99.

acquisition: The tangleroot is a skilling pet that can be obtained when checking the health (for patches that have this option, like fruit trees ) or when harvesting the final crop (for patches without a "Check-health" option) of a farming patch . It may also be obtained while playing the Tithe Farm minigame or from killing the Hespori . The chances of getting it are dependent on the player's Farming level and the crop the player is harvesting.

Unlike pets such as the rock golem , an incoming farming resource such as a herb or hespori seed will take precedence over the farming pet. If the player already has a follower and the remaining inventory slots are then filled by an incoming farming resource, the player will not receive the pet and must instead claim it from Probita in East Ardougne . Should the player obtain the pet while harvesting giant seaweed , the pet will not be lost upon drowning .
A player's actual chances of receiving it is 1 in B - ( Lvl * 25) , where B is the base chance and Lvl is the player's Farming level.

The fastest method on average to receive Tangleroot is by frequently farming cactus (NOT potato cactus ), belladonna , hespori , giant seaweed , and mushrooms , as well as doing regular tree runs. Although using only trees takes the least amount of time spent on Farming (thus being more efficient), it is extremely slow in real time, taking upwards of two years on average with daily tree runs.

It surpasses its predecessor, the fire cape , boasting greater melee attack and strength bonuses, along with slightly higher defensive bonuses. In spite of this, it is still surpassed by the Ardougne cloaks 3 and 4 in stab attack and prayer bonuses, and by the mythical cape in crush attack.

21387.title: Master scroll book
21387.intro: A master scroll book is an item obtainable from any level Treasure Trail except beginner. If a reward casket would reward any type of teleport scroll , there is a 1/23 chance for it to reward a master scroll book instead.
acquisition: A master scroll book is an item obtainable from any level Treasure Trail except beginner. If a reward casket would reward any type of teleport scroll , there is a 1/23 chance for it to reward a master scroll book instead.

The master scroll book can store up to 1000 of every type of teleport scroll, which is done by "using" the scroll with the book. Currently, to fill the entire book with 1000 teleports it would cost 216,477,000 coins .

Players can exchange a master scroll book with Watson to receive 10-20 Watson teleport scrolls . This currently results in a profit of between −18,621 and 28,419 coins per master scroll book exchanged, with an average profit of 4,899 coins . Exchanging a master scroll book with scrolls inside does not cause the player to lose the scrolls, though the player must have or obtain another book to access them.
Empty master scroll books can now be exchanged with Watson to receive 10-20 teleport scrolls to his house .

22481.title: Sanguinesti staff
22481.intro: The Sanguinesti staff is a one-handed powered staff requiring 82 Magic to wield, available as a rare drop from the Theatre of Blood . Like most powered staves, it is only tradeable when it is fully uncharged. Named after the Sanguinesti region , the staff was crafted by Lord Lowerniel Drakan himself, and was given to Lady Verzik Vitur as a gift for her assistance in the Misthalin–Morytania War .
acquisition: The staff has a unique passive effect granting its built-in magic spell Life leech properties. Successful hits with the spell have a 1/5 (20%) chance of dealing 8 additional damage and healing the user half the amount of hitpoints dealt to a target. This healing effect has a visible 'upwards spiral' on the enemy when triggered.

To use the staff's magic spell, it must be charged with blood runes , holding up to 20,000 charges when fully charged. Each cast requires 2 blood runes, costing 678 coins per cast. Players can configure the charges while the weapon is in their bank by right-clicking on Configure-Charges, as long as players have the required materials. The total cost to fully charge the staff with 40,000 blood runes is 13,560,000 coins . Assuming non-stop use, with one cast every 2.4 seconds equalling 1,500 casts per hour, the staff costs 1,017,000 coins per hour to use.

The base maximum hit dealt by the staff is dependent on the player's current Magic level, starting at 27 with level 82 Magic and increasing by one every three Magic levels, up to a maximum of 41 at level 123 (obtainable only through smelling salts in Tombs of Amascut ). Both magic damage bonuses and visible stat boosts will modify the max hit of the spell; likewise, stat-reductions will lower the damage. Invisible boosts, such as from the staff's attack styles, do not affect the max hit. The staff always has a maximum hit of at least 6, even when reduced to 0 magic. Compared to the other three powered staves, the trident of the seas has a lower base maximum hit by 5 (max of 20 at level 75),
First present in the Theatre of Blood Rewards beta.

acquisition: Charges added to the scythe can be returned by using the scythe on the vyre well in Ver Sinhaza. These charges may then be withdrawn from the well to receive the blood runes and vials of blood back. Uncharging outside the well, however, will not return blood runes or vials of blood.
In the event of a PvP death, if the scythe is not protected, all charges will be lost and the player who gets the scythe will not receive any blood runes or vials of blood.

When worn, all drops received from NPCs within the Revenant Caves , Wilderness Slayer Cave and Chaos Temple will be in the form of bank notes , except for secondary supply rolls and uniques. However, equipping the amulet will cause the player to become skulled , similar to the cape of skulls . Attempting to equip the amulet gives a warning telling the player that this will happen. Players can speak to Arno if they wish to stop randomly receiving Hespori seeds as they harvest, clear, or check the health of their crops around Gielinor.

Hespori seeds are most commonly dropped from plants grown in Special patches ; players looking to fight Hespori more often should consider growing cactus , nightshade , mushrooms and giant seaweed. Giant seaweed is a popular choice as the seaweed spores are easily obtainable, grow quickly, and have a 1/15 chance to drop a Hespori seed; similar to the Tangleroot, this is rolled on the last harvesting attempt.

If the player has no room in their inventory, they will not receive a Hespori seed. In most cases, the chance of receiving a Hespori seed is 500 times the base chance of the Tangleroot . At 99 Farming, the effective chance of Tangleroot per Hespori seeds received is between 1/252.2 and 1/497.3. Note this is outside Tithe farm and does not account for Hespori seeds received from seed packs .

Where P is the contribution points awarded to the player, H is damage to hitpoints, and S is damage to shield. 23953.title: Crystal tool seed
23953.intro: The crystal tool seed is an elven crystal that can be turned into the crystal axe , crystal harpoon , or crystal pickaxe , using 120 crystal shards and the dragon counterpart on a singing bowl . It can be obtained as a drop from Zalcano .
acquisition: The crystal tool seed is an elven crystal that can be turned into the crystal axe , crystal harpoon , or crystal pickaxe , using 120 crystal shards and the dragon counterpart on a singing bowl . It can be obtained as a drop from Zalcano .

The crystal tools start off at 10,000 charges and degrades, like other crystal equipment . One charge is depleted for each time an item is obtained using the tool, with some exceptions for particular uses of the axe and pickaxe where the crystal version has no additional benefit (duplicates from items such as the Varrock armour do not deplete an extra charge). The player may add charges with crystal shards , with each shard granting 100 charges, up to a maximum of 20,000 charges. Dismantling a crystal tool will return the dragon equivalent and crystal tool seed to the player and doing so will lose all crystal shard charges that were previously loaded.
Players can also exchange the tool seed for 100 crystal shards by speaking to Amrod in Prifddinas ' Hefin Inn .

acquisition: The blood shard is a drop from vyrewatch sentinels , venators , and from pickpocketing vampyres in Darkmeyer . Whether the ring is or isn't charged, it provides players an invisible +4 boost to Mining ; this stacks with both visible and invisible boosts. This bonus does not allow the player to receive ores higher than their level range or deal more damage within the Path of Het puzzle room.

When charged, the ring has 1/10 chance of giving an extra resource when mining rocks up to adamantite , with some exceptions , granting experience for both mined resources. If the player has only one inventory slot remaining and the ring's passive effect activates, the player will lose out on both the extra resource and the extra experience. This effect can trigger independently of other mining enhancers .

acquisition: Spirit flakes are a fishing enhancer item received from looting the reward pool after defeating Tempoross . On average, 12 are received per reward permit. They can be stored in a tackle box .

They are used in Fishing to give a 50% chance of yielding double catch everywhere (with some exceptions ), at the cost of one flake per fish caught, although no additional experience is given. This effect stacks with Rada's blessing allowing for an additional 2%-8% chance of catching double the fish, depending on which tier of the Kourend & Kebos Diary the player has completed.

Spirit flakes can also be used to purchase the fish barrel and tackle box from Flakes 'n' Flotsam , each costing 6,000.

acquisition: The coal bag is a reward purchasable from Prospector Percy's Nugget Shop for 100 golden nuggets . The coal bag holds up to 27 pieces of coal (36 if a Smithing cape is equipped). When smelting or superheating , coal in the bag will be used after the coal in the inventory . It is refillable just like essence pouches , though unlike an essence pouch, it does not degrade . This is useful for both mining and smithing as it effectively doubles the amount of coal a player can carry and thus the number of bars a player can make per inventory of ore. Coal placed inside the bag will not add additional weight to your character until removed from the coal bag.

Only one coal bag may be in the player's possession at any time. It cannot be traded or dropped but it can be destroyed if it is empty. Players may sell their coal bag back to Percy in exchange for golden nuggets equal to 80% of its original cost (80 golden nuggets ).

26815.title: Ring of the elements
26815.intro: The ring of the elements is an item purchased from the Guardians of the Rift reward shop for 400 abyssal pearls . It teleports players near the elemental runic altars . It also counts as a piece of warm clothing at Wintertodt , regardless of charge. When charged, the ring is untradeable.

It also counts as a piece of warm clothing at Wintertodt , regardless of charge. When charged, the ring is untradeable.

The ring is charged by using one of each elemental rune ( air , earth , fire , water ) and one law rune together on the ring, costing 144 per teleport. The ring can hold up to 10,000 charges, costing 1,440,000 to fully charge. The number of charges is tracked by player, meaning a second ring owned by the player will have the same number of charges as the first. Players can receive the runes back through the ring's right-click "Uncharge" option while at almost any bank .
The "Check" option on the charged ring has been changed to "Uncharge", allowing players to receive the runes used upon doing so.

26820.title: Guardian's eye

26945.title: Pharaoh's sceptre
26945.intro: The pharaoh's sceptre is a polestaff found during the Pyramid Plunder minigame in Sophanem , from the golden chests and sarcophagi . It requires 30 Attack and 30 Magic to wield.
acquisition: Players must commune with the obelisk with the sceptre in your inventory before being able to teleport here. The sceptre does not need to be charged for communing to unlock the teleport.

Simon's purchase price may be useful for ironmen when comparing which artefacts to save for charges. As a general rule, using Gold artefacts are the most costly options.

Pharaoh's sceptres are a very rare reward received from the golden chests and sarcophagi during the Pyramid Plunder minigame. The chance of receiving a pharaoh's sceptre scales depending on the room. When a player finds the sceptre, they are immediately ejected from the pyramid. If the player had no free inventory space when they found the sceptre, it will appear on the ground under them when they are outside the pyramid.

27012.title: Double ammo mould
27012.intro: The double ammo mould is an item that makes cannonballs twice as fast compared to a regular ammo mould , making 8 cannonballs rather than 4 (and using 2 metal bars rather than 1) per action.
acquisition: It can be purchased from the Giants' Foundry reward shop for 2,000 Foundry Reputation if Dwarf Cannon is complete. On average, using Steel-Mithril longswords with only optimal moulds (requiring up to 81 Smithing ), obtaining a double ammo mould takes around 75 minutes of gameplay. With only default moulds, it takes 15 minutes more.

27014.title: Kovac's grog
27014.intro: Kovac's grog is a type of ale that restores 1 Hitpoint and temporarily boosts Smithing by 4 while draining Attack , Ranged , and Magic by 2. This provides the second highest Smithing boost available, surpassing the mature dwarven stout's 2-level boost. Furthermore, this is a reliable boost, unlike orange spicy stew which may boost or drain the player by up to 5 levels when 3 dashes of orange spice are added.
acquisition: It can be purchased from the Giants' Foundry reward shop for 300 Foundry Reputation . Each serving of Kovac's grog is worth 82,410 coins , or 274.7 coins per Reputation point.
This item cannot be traded back to the shop for Foundry Reputation. Ironman players are presented with an Easter egg message if they try to exchange the grog for Foundry Reputation.

27017.title: Smithing catalyst
27017.intro: Smithing catalyst is a consumable item purchased from the Giants' Foundry reward shop for 15 Foundry Reputation .
acquisition: Smithing catalyst is a consumable item purchased from the Giants' Foundry reward shop for 15 Foundry Reputation .
Based on the opportunity cost of using Foundry Reputation to buy catalyst instead of Kovac's grog to sell on the Grand Exchange , each Smithing catalyst costs 4,120.5 coins .

It should be noted that the catalyzed section only takes into account the opportunity cost of buying Kovac's grog instead. As acquiring the catalyst requires playing the Giants' Foundry instead of spending that time smelting metals, another opportunity cost applies not only to gold earnings, but to experience earnings as well.

The probabilities in this section are an estimation based on the data of opening 1913 ore packs, totaling 57390 ores being obtained.

27277.title: Tumeken's shadow

acquisition: The total cost to fully charge the staff with 40,000 soul and 100,000 chaos runes is 26,040,000 coins . Assuming non-stop use, with one cast every 3 seconds equaling 1200 casts per hour, the shadow costs 1,562,400 coins per hour to use.
The item has been added to the Grand Exchange's item sink list .

27279.title: Thread of Elidinis
27279.intro: The thread of Elidinis is an uncommon reward from the rewards chest within the Tombs of Amascut . Players with 75 Crafting can use the thread on a rune pouch with a needle in their inventory to create a divine rune pouch , which can store four types of runes instead of three. This process can be reversed to return both items.
acquisition: The thread of Elidinis is an uncommon reward from the rewards chest within the Tombs of Amascut . Players with 75 Crafting can use the thread on a rune pouch with a needle in their inventory to create a divine rune pouch , which can store four types of runes instead of three. This process can be reversed to return both items.

The base rate of receiving the thread is 1/10. To mitigate bad luck , the rate is scaled linearly with the number of raid completions, up to a maximum of 3/10 upon completing 15 raids. Once the player gets their first thread, the drop rate is decreased to 1/50. Additionally, players can buy the thread from Perdu for 350,000 coins if they have obtained it from the Tombs of Amascut at least once.

27372.title: Masori crafting kit
27372.intro: The Masori crafting kit is an ornament kit obtained from the Tombs of Amascut that can be used on an Ava's assembler or an Assembler max cape along with a needle or costume needle to create a Masori assembler or Masori assembler max cape , respectively. This alters its appearance to match the appearance of Masori armour . It is solely a cosmetic upgrade and does not change the stats.
acquisition: The Masori crafting kit is an ornament kit obtained from the Tombs of Amascut that can be used on an Ava's assembler or an Assembler max cape along with a needle or costume needle to create a Masori assembler or Masori assembler max cape , respectively. In order to receive one from the Tombs of Amascut reward chest , players must complete a raid at level 350+ with zero deaths for all party members while also scoring at least 1500 points. Additionally, if a player is already in possession of a Masori crafting kit or Masori assembler, it is not possible to receive another without dropping the item on the ground before opening the reward chest.

acquisition: Ancient essence is a drop received from defeating the Phantom Muspah . An average Phantom Muspah kill will drop 765.4 essence (counting frozen cache loot, not counting breaking down items.) It can also be obtained by mining ancient essence crystals in the Ghorrock Dungeon with 75 Mining , granting 13.5 Mining experience. It is used to create the saturated heart and forgotten brews . Ancient essence can also be obtained by breaking down ancient icons and venator shards . Ancient icons give 5,000 essence, while venator shards give 50,000 essence.

When mining the essence, it can be found in one of 3 spots in the wall just south of the entrance to the Phantom Muspah fight. Only one spot will be active, switching between spots randomly with possibly 60 to 90 seconds between each movement, similar to daeyalt essence rocks . Gems can also be obtained while mining, as is the case with most mines.

27643.title: Charged ice
27643.intro: Charged ice is a tertiary drop from the Phantom Muspah , guaranteed as a drop if it is killed in under three minutes. It is used on a Muphin to allow it to metamorphose into its melee and shielded forms. Once used on Muphin, it cannot be obtained again, even if the player gets another kill under three minutes.
acquisition: Charged ice is a tertiary drop from the Phantom Muspah , guaranteed as a drop if it is killed in under three minutes. It is used on a Muphin to allow it to metamorphose into its melee and shielded forms. Once used on Muphin, it cannot be obtained again, even if the player gets another kill under three minutes.

One way to quicken kill times is to use only a crossbow, relying on the effects of enchanted ruby bolts during its melee and ranged phases, enchanted sapphire bolts during its shielded phase, and enchanted diamond bolts for its post-shield phase. A Zaryte crossbow or Armadyl crossbow is recommended for this, due to their special attacks affecting enchanted bolts (the Zaryte crossbow guarantees activation and passively strengthens its effects, while the Armadyl crossbow doubles base chance of activation). Players who can afford both a tumeken's shadow and twisted bow can easily make the time without having to rely on bolt activation.
The item now has a "Drop" option instead of "Destroy". Previously, the destroy text was "You will have to obtain another one from the Phantom Muspah."

27667.title: Claws of Callisto
27667.intro: The claws of Callisto are an item dropped by Callisto and Artio . They are used to upgrade Viggora's chainmace into an Ursine chainmace . This process requires level 85 Smithing ; players without the required level to combine the items may ask Andros Mai in Ferox Enclave to do so instead, for a fee of 500,000 coins . The uncharged weapon may be dismantled to separate the chainmace and claws.

The uncharged weapon may be dismantled to separate the bow and fangs.

28140.title: Log basket
28140.intro: A log basket is an item that allows players to store a combined total of 28 logs of any type. The basket can be purchased from the Forestry Shop for 300 noted oak logs , 300 noted willow logs , and 5,000 anima-infused bark . Players (excluding Ultimate Ironmen ) can sell the basket back to the rewards shop for an 80% return of the cost to purchase. The basket must be closed before being sold back.
acquisition: A log basket is an item that allows players to store a combined total of 28 logs of any type. The basket can be purchased from the Forestry Shop for 300 noted oak logs , 300 noted willow logs , and 5,000 anima-infused bark . Players (excluding Ultimate Ironmen ) can sell the basket back to the rewards shop for an 80% return of the cost to purchase. The basket must be closed before being sold back.

Players can automatically store logs in their basket whilst chopping a tree if they select the "Open" option. Players can check the basket's contents by selecting the "Check" right-click option. This tells the number and type of logs the player has inside, and provides an option to empty the logs into the player's inventory. The basket does not store fungi collected through cutting sulliuscep , bruma roots obtained at Wintertodt , charcoal , or any type of pyre logs . Although not traditionally considered "logs," the bark cut from hollow trees can be stored in the log basket. Note that chopping regular trees with any Kandarin headgear will result in the extra log in the player's inventory an

Players may deposit the logs inside the basket to a bank or a bank deposit box by right-clicking "Empty" on the item whilst the bank interface is open. Players wearing the basket can deposit their logs by using the "Empty containers" button in the Bank UI. Multiple baskets may be purchased; however, they have a linked inventory. This link is also shared with the Forestry basket .
Note: Purchasing also requires 300 oak logs ( noted ) and 300 willow logs ( noted ) in addition to the anima-infused bark.

28334.title: Awakener's orb
28334.intro: Awakener's orbs are items dropped by the Forgotten Four bosses fought during Desert Treasure II . The orbs can be used to fight stronger variants of those bosses.
acquisition: While the awakened variants have a higher chance for uniques, they are not meant to be farmed for such items, due to the cost of the orbs, longer kills and the significant spike in difficulty compared to the bosses' normal fights. The main purpose of using orbs is to kill all four awakened bosses for the ancient blood ornament kit , which turns Torva armour into its cosmetic Sanguine torva armour .
Awakener's orbs have been added to the collection log . Any orb obtained via the bosses before this update will not appear in the log.

28583.title: Warped sceptre
28583.intro: The warped sceptre is a powered staff requiring 62 Magic to wield, available as a drop from warped terrorbirds or warped tortoises with level 56 Slayer . Like most powered staves, it is only tradeable when it is fully uncharged.

28613.title: Cape pouch
28613.intro: The cape pouch is an item purchased from the Forestry Shop for 2,500 anima-infused bark . This pouch is used on the Forestry kit or Forestry basket with level 99 Woodcutting, allowing the player to store the Woodcutting cape within, to receive the skillcape benefits whilst wearing the Forestry kit instead to save an extra inventory slot.
acquisition: The cape pouch is an item purchased from the Forestry Shop for 2,500 anima-infused bark . This pouch is used on the Forestry kit or Forestry basket with level 99 Woodcutting, allowing the player to store the Woodcutting cape within, to receive the skillcape benefits whilst wearing the Forestry kit instead to save an extra inventory slot.
Unlike the clothes pouch upgrade, the Forestry kit or basket must be equipped to receive the benefits of a Woodcutting cape stored inside; merely carrying it in the inventory is not sufficient.
Players can sell the pouch back to the shop to get 80% of its cost back (2,000 bark).
