28626.title: Fox whistle
28626.intro: The fox whistle is a rare reward from the Poachers Forestry event . It is used on the beaver pet to allow it to metamorphose into a fox . It is consumed in the process.
acquisition: The fox whistle is a rare reward from the Poachers Forestry event . It is used on the beaver pet to allow it to metamorphose into a fox . It is consumed in the process.

There is a 1/30 chance to retrieve a fox whistle at the end of the event, provided a player is eligible to receive the full rewards of the event (meaning the player disarmed at least 1 trap). Upon receiving one, it will be placed in the inventory (or on the ground if it is full), and a game message in the chatbox will state Well done, you've saved the fox from the poachers! The fox has left you a gift... You feel a connection to the fox as if it wishes to travel with you... .
Alternatively, players can purchase the fox whistle for 75,000 anima bark from the Forestry Shop . It can also be sold to the Forestry Shop for 250 anima-infused bark .
Unique drops from forestry events are now received in the inventory, provided that there is space.

28630.title: Twitcher's gloves
28630.intro: Twitcher's gloves are an item purchased from the Forestry Shop for 5,000 anima-infused bark and 500 noted willow logs .
acquisition: Twitcher's gloves are an item purchased from the Forestry Shop for 5,000 anima-infused bark and 500 noted willow logs .

Whilst equipped, the player will have a 20% increased chance to receive a specific type of bird nest whenever they receive one from Woodcutting ; the player can right-click "Settings" on the gloves to specify which type: Ring , Egg , Seed , or Clue . This effect stacks with the effects of a strung rabbit foot . Additionally, although redwood trees only yield clue nests when cut, the gloves can still increase the chance of getting clue nests.
When purchasing these gloves, you receive a chatbox message stating "Remember, you must wear these gloves to receive their bonus."

28655.title: Petal garland
28655.intro: The Petal garland is a purely cosmetic neck slot item that can be obtained as a possible reward from the Enchantment Ritual Forestry event . Note that the petal garland cannot be stored in a player-owned house .
acquisition: The Petal garland is a purely cosmetic neck slot item that can be obtained as a possible reward from the Enchantment Ritual Forestry event . Note that the petal garland cannot be stored in a player-owned house .

There is a fixed chance of 1/30 to receive the petal garland upon completing at least one step of the ritual, provided the player was eligible for the full rewards of the event. When receiving one, a game message in the chatbox will state The Dryad also hands you a Petal garland.
The drop rate for the Petal Garland has been adjusted to 1 in 30 (previously 1 in 50).

28663.title: Golden pheasant egg
28663.intro: The Golden pheasant egg is a rare reward from the Pheasant Control Forestry event . It is used on the beaver pet to allow it to metamorphose into a pheasant . It is consumed in the process.
acquisition: The Golden pheasant egg is a rare reward from the Pheasant Control Forestry event . It is used on the beaver pet to allow it to metamorphose into a pheasant . It is consumed in the process.

Unlike the fox whistle , the golden pheasant egg can be obtained mid-way through the event rather than only at the end. Alternatively, the golden pheasant egg can be purchased for 75,000 anima bark from the Forestry Shop .

There is a chance to retrieve a golden pheasant egg from a pheasant nest , provided a player is eligible to receive the reward from the event; the rate is approximately 1/1500 for every regular pheasant egg retrieved. Upon receiving one, it will be placed in the inventory (or on the ground if it is full), and a game message in the chatbox will state You feel a connection to the pheasants as if one wishes to travel with you...

Only one roll for the golden pheasant egg is made upon looting a pheasant nest, after which no more rolls are given until the regular pheasant egg is turned in to the Freaky Forester . As such, repeatedly destroying regular pheasant eggs will not increase one's chance of receiving the drop.

acquisition: If a player's inventory is full and they have a follower already, they will not receive the pet; it must instead be claimed from Probita in East Ardougne .

28997.title: Dual macuahuitl
28997.intro: The dual macuahuitl (in English pronounced roughly mah- KWAH -weetl ) is a non-degradable two-handed spiked weapon that requires level 70 Attack and 75 Strength to equip, which is obtained as a possible reward from the Lunar Chest in Neypotzli .
acquisition: The dual macuahuitl (in English pronounced roughly mah- KWAH -weetl ) is a non-degradable two-handed spiked weapon that requires level 70 Attack and 75 Strength to equip, which is obtained as a possible reward from the Lunar Chest in Neypotzli .

The dual macuahuitl has a special attack , Blood Infusion , which costs 25% special attack energy, requires the full blood moon armour set to use, and takes 25% of the player's current Hitpoints (rounded down, meaning no damage is taken below 4 Hitpoints ), regardless of whether you hit or miss.

In exchange, the special attack removes the sequential accuracy check, so both hitsplats roll accuracy independently for that attack, meaning a miss on the first one no longer guarantees a miss on the second. Each hitsplat's accuracy is also increased by 25%, and the player's maximum hit is increased by 25%, calculated before the total is split across the two hitsplats. Additionally, the Bloodrager set effect is guaranteed to trigger if either hitsplat hits.

acquisition: Sulphur blades are a two-handed weapon that requires level 55 Attack to wield, obtained as a rare drop from sulphur nagua in Neypotzli . 29309.intro: The huntsman's kit can be obtained from hunters' loot sacks , which are received as rewards upon completing Hunters' Rumours . The huntsman's kit can be used to store various hunting equipment, though they cannot be used whilst stored.

29455.title: Teleport anchoring scroll
29455.intro: A teleport anchoring scroll is an item obtained as loot from zombie pirates and Zombie Pirate's Lockers . It can be read to become permanently impervious to teleport attacks by elder chaos druids and abyssal demons . This effect will not apply to teleport attacks from the Abyssal Sire , the Confusion attack of the Chaos Elemental , or the Tele Block spell.

29482.title: Brimhaven voucher
29482.intro: A Brimhaven voucher is received while participating in the Brimhaven Agility Arena . One voucher and one Agility Arena ticket is earned for tagging a ticket dispenser . They are exchanged at the Agility Arena Store by talking to Pirate Jackie the Fruit for items.

29574.title: Burning claw
29574.intro: A burning claw is an item rarely dropped by Tormented Demons . Two are used on each other in order to create the burning claws .
acquisition: The item's Grand Exchange value was manually increased from 1,000,000 to 25,000,000.

29580.title: Tormented synapse
29580.intro: The tormented synapse is an item obtained as a rare drop from tormented demons , found in the Ancient Guthix Temple after completion of While Guthix Sleeps .

The item's Grand Exchange value was manually increased from 1,500,000 to 60,000,000.

29684.title: Guthixian temple teleport
29684.intro: Guthixian temple teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to the entrance of the Ancient Guthixian Temple . They can be obtained as a drop from Tormented Demons . They can be stored in the master scroll book .

29781.title: Coagulated venom
29781.intro: Coagulated venom is a tertiary drop from Araxxor that can be used on Nid to allow it to metamorphose into Rax . The drop is guaranteed if Araxxor is killed under 1:15. Once used on Nid, it cannot be obtained again. Nid must be following the player, you cannot use this while Nid is in your inventory, or in the player's pet menagerie in their player-owned house.

29782.title: Spider cave teleport
29782.intro: Spider cave teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to the entrance of the Morytania Spider Cave . They can be obtained from defeating Araxxor .
acquisition: Spider cave teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to the entrance of the Morytania Spider Cave . They can be obtained from defeating Araxxor .

29784.title: Araxyte venom sac
29784.intro: Araxyte venom sacs are items dropped by araxytes that serve as both a consumable and as a secondary ingredient used to create extended anti-venom+ potions. Each sac can upgrade one dose of anti-venom+ into a dose of extended anti-venom+ , with this process requiring level 94 Herblore .
acquisition: They can also be eaten to instantly cure venom and poison . Since they function as a normal piece of food, they can be combo eaten with karambwans . They provide immunity to poison for 11.7 minutes and venom for 0–18 seconds at the cost of dealing 4 venom damage a single time to the player; unlike most other sources of self-inflicted damage , this can kill the player. This is mostly done when acquired as a drop mid-trip, whilst the player has run out of anti-venom to drink. As they are stackable, they may also be used as protection from poison for very long trips whilst only taking one inventory space, such as during Dagannoth Kings tasks.

29786.title: Jar of Venom
29786.intro: The jar of venom is a rare untradeable drop from Araxxor that can be used on a boss lair display in a player's Achievement Gallery to have a display of Araxxor.

29788.title: Araxyte head
29788.intro: The araxyte head is a rare drop from araxytes , as well as Araxxor . It can be combined with a slayer helmet or slayer helmet (i) to create an araxyte slayer helmet or araxyte slayer helmet (i) , respectively. Doing so requires purchasing the ability Eye see you for 1,000 Slayer reward points .
acquisition: The araxyte head is a rare drop from araxytes , as well as Araxxor . Doing so requires purchasing the ability Eye see you for 1,000 Slayer reward points .
The araxyte head is an indirect requirement for recolouring the amulet of rancour to its silver variant , as an araxyte slayer helmet is required to obtain the recolour.

29790.title: Noxious point
29790.intro: The noxious point is a rare drop from Araxxor . It can be combined with the noxious blade and noxious pommel to create the noxious halberd .

29792.title: Noxious blade
29792.intro: The noxious blade is a rare drop from Araxxor . It can be combined with the noxious point and noxious pommel to create the noxious halberd .

29794.title: Noxious pommel
29794.intro: The noxious pommel is a rare drop from Araxxor . It can be combined with the noxious point and noxious blade to create the noxious halberd .

29799.title: Araxyte fang
29799.intro: The araxyte fang is an item dropped by Araxxor . With a Crafting level of 86, it can be etched using a chisel to produce the tradeable etched araxyte fang , which is used to upgrade the amulet of torture into the amulet of rancour , giving 500 Crafting experience.
acquisition: Based on Grand Exchange prices, the araxyte fang is worth 31,421,838 if used to upgrade an amulet of torture.

29806.title: Aranea boots
29806.intro: Aranea boots are a pair of boots dropped by araxytes . With no requirements to wear, they are currently the best-in-slot boots for one-defence pures and zerkers , due to the tribrid stats they have, with a ranged attack bonus between that of mixed hide boots and blessed dragonhide boots , a magic attack bonus equal to infinity boots , and a melee strength bonus equal to dragon boots .
acquisition: If players are on a Slayer task for spiders or araxytes, the drop rate of aranea boots is improved from 1/4,000 to 1/1,600 or 1/2,000 to 1/800 depending on the araxyte's combat level.

29836.title: Nid
29836.intro: Nid is an araxyte pet dropped by Araxxor . It is a much smaller version of Araxxor . Players can right click " Metamorph " to change between Nid and Rax by using the coagulated venom , which unlocks the ability to do so.
acquisition: Nid is an araxyte pet dropped by Araxxor . It is a much smaller version of Araxxor . Players can right click " Metamorph " to change between Nid and Rax by using the coagulated venom , which unlocks the ability to do so.
If a player's inventory is full and they have a follower already, they will not receive the pet; it must instead be claimed from Probita in East Ardougne .

When Araxxor dies, players can choose to either harvest or destroy the corpse. Choosing the "Harvest" option rolls the drop table as normal, including a chance to receive Nid. Choosing the "Destroy" option will roll for Nid at double the drop rate, but will forfeit all other potential loot (aside from elite clue scrolls ).

29892.title: Pendant of Ates
29892.intro: The Pendant of Ates is an amulet that can be charged to provide teleports to six locations around Varlamore . The pendant is an untradeable rare drop from killing frost naguas or Amoxliatl .
acquisition: Upon obtaining the pendant, it is inert and uncharged. Each frozen tear provides one charge, and the necklace holds up to 1,000 charges. The charges can be refunded, returning the tears used to charge it and reverting the pendant to its inert state.
No teleports are available by default. To unlock locations, a player must first activate the statue of ates at each location.

It is possible to obtain multiple pendants; however, the charges are not shared, and multiple charged pendants will not stack in the bank. Extra pendants can be dismantled, providing 100 frozen tears, giving the item an indirect value of 31,100 .
The Pendant of Ates has 6 teleport locations, each of which must be unlocked by activating the statue of ates at the location.

29895.title: Frozen tear
29895.intro: Frozen tears are a drop from creatures within the Ruins of Tapoyauik . They are used to charge the Pendant of Ates , in which each tear provides one teleport charge.
acquisition: 100 frozen tears can also be obtained by dismantling an inert Pendant of Ates.

29974.title: Prescription goggles
29974.intro: The prescription goggles are a piece of the alchemist's outfit purchased from the Mixology Rewards shop with 8,600 Mox resin , 7,000 Aga resin , and 9,350 Lye resin , which are earned from participating in the Mastering Mixology minigame. The goggles can be cosmetically changed between a focused and unfocused variant when in the inventory.
acquisition: The prescription goggles are a piece of the alchemist's outfit purchased from the Mixology Rewards shop with 8,600 Mox resin , 7,000 Aga resin , and 9,350 Lye resin , which are earned from participating in the Mastering Mixology minigame. As saved ingredients may be used in subsequent potions, the effect compounds on itself, making each secondary worth ~1.111 potions.
They can be sold back to the Mixology Rewards shop for 3,440 mox resin, 2,800 aga resin, and 3,740 lye resin.

29992.title: Alchemist's amulet
29992.intro: The alchemist's amulet is an item purchased from the Mixology Rewards shop with 6,900 Mox resin , 5,650 Aga resin , and 7,400 Lye resin , which are earned from participating in the Mastering Mixology minigame. While the amulet is equipped, there is a 15% chance the player will create a potion with an extra dose when brewing potions (but with no extra experience), which consumes one charge. This effect works when adding seconda
acquisition: The alchemist's amulet is an item purchased from the Mixology Rewards shop with 6,900 Mox resin , 5,650 Aga resin , and 7,400 Lye resin , which are earned from participating in the Mastering Mixology minigame. While the amulet is equipped, there is a 15% chance the player will create a potion with an extra dose when brewing potions (but with no extra experience), which consumes one charge. This effect works when adding secondaries to potions with fewer than 4 doses, such as anti-venom and stamina potions .

When first purchased, the amulet is pre-charged with 50 uses. Additional charges can be added by using amulets of chemistry on it, each giving 10 charges, up to a maximum of 5,000. On average, each Amulet of chemistry added will last for ~67 potions made, giving a fully charged Alchemist's amulet ~33,333 potions made, of which 5,000 will have an extra dose.

Since each amulet of chemistry adds ten charges, whereas the amulet of chemistry itself only has 5 charges, the cost per charge of using the Alchemist's amulet is effectively half that of the amulet of chemistry. When using the amulet for solely profit, it should only be used when a single dose of the potion you make has a value of more than 1/10th of the requisite amulet of chemistry's worth ( 154.5 coins ).
The Alchemist's Amulet can no longer be purchased when the player has no space in their inventory.

acquisition: The chugging barrel is a tradeable item that allows players to consume up to five potions in a single click. It is purchased from the Mixology Rewards shop at a cost of 17,250 Mox resin , 14,000 Aga resin , and 18,600 Lye resin . It is sold in a disassembled state (where it cannot store potions); players must use the 'Assemble' option in order for the barrel to become useable. The player is not required to have done the Mastering Mixology mini-game to assemble it. The barrel is only tradeable in its disassembled state. While the assembled barrel is untradeable, it is possible to dismantle the barrel at any time, although doing so will cause all potions currently stored inside to be lost.

Ultimate Ironmen are able to store potion doses inside the chugging barrel and consume potions from it. However, they cannot set loadouts as it requires the use of a bank interface to do so. Its contents are also preserved even when the barrel is lost or deleted on death, able to be accessed after assembling a new chugging barrel. This allows it to be used for ghost storage , although due to the time investment to reobtain the barrel, this is not very useful.

acquisition: The helm can be obtained directly as a drop from Yama , or created via Smithing by combining 2,520 crushed infernal shale with 450 oathplate shards to make 9 infernal plates , then using them to smith one piece of oathplate armour.

30759.intro: The soulflame horn is a weapon obtained as a rare drop from Yama that requires level 80 Magic to equip. The horn's main appeal is its special attack, which empowers nearby players' next melee attack, allowing its user to fill a support role in group content.

acquisition: Earthbound tecpatl are a two-handed stab sword that require level 55 Attack to wield, obtained as a rare drop from earthen nagua in the Tonali Cavern . Like their crush and slash equivalents, the glacial temotli and sulphur blades , it performs two independently rolled hits per attack . The maximum damage of each hit is determined by calculating the combined max hit as normal and dividing it by two. If the combined max hit is odd, one max hit is rounded up while the other is rounded down (e.g., 45 → 22 + 23). As a multi-hit weapon , it is especially useful against monsters that have negative flat armour , such as Nagua , since all successful hits will do an extra damage to them.

31109.intro: Mokhaiotl cloth is an item dropped by the Doom of Mokhaiotl . It is used alongside 10,000 demon tears to upgrade the tormented bracelet into the confliction gauntlets .

31111.title: Demon tear
31111.intro: Demon tears are items used to charge the Eye of Ayak as an alternative to runes, or as part of the materials required to create the avernic treads and confliction gauntlets .
acquisition: They are primarily obtained as drops from the Doom of Mokhaiotl . Alternatively, they can also be obtained by chopping infected roots in the Ruins of Mokhaiotl with 80 Woodcutting , providing a non-combat method of acquisition similar to that of Zulrah's scales from sacred eels . The Eye of Ayak can also be dismantled for 10,000 demon tears.

31115.title: Eye of Ayak
31115.intro: The Eye of Ayak is a one-handed powered staff that requires level 83 Magic to wield. It is a drop from the Doom of Mokhaiotl upon completion of delve level 3 and higher. Like most powered staves, it is only tradeable when it is fully uncharged.
acquisition: To use the staff's built-in spell, it must either be charged with demon tears or with both death and chaos runes . It can hold up to 50,000 charges, enough for 25 hours of continuous combat. Each cast consumes either one demon tear, or two death runes and one chaos rune, depending on what the staff is charged with. Using demon tears costs 248 coins per charge, while using runes costs 488 coins per charge. The eye cannot contain both demon tear charges and rune-based charges at the same time.

The total cost to fully charge the staff with 50,000 demon tears is 12,400,000 coins . Assuming non-stop use, with one cast every 1.8 seconds equaling 2,000 casts per hour, the Eye costs 496,000 coins per hour to use with tears.

The total cost to fully charge the staff with 100,000 death and 50,000 chaos runes is 24,400,000 coins . Assuming non-stop use, with one cast every 1.8 seconds equalling 2,000 casts per hour, the Eye costs 976,000 coins per hour to use with runes.

31130.title: Dom
31130.intro: Dom is a pet dropped by the Doom of Mokhaiotl , and is a much smaller version of it. Dom can only be dropped upon completion of delve level of 6 or higher.
acquisition: The first Dom players receive will cause the burrow hole to glow; subsequent Doms will not do so, even if the player loses it.
If a player's inventory is full and they have a follower already, they will not receive the pet; it must instead be claimed from Probita in East Ardougne .

Upon equipping the horn, the player will blow the horn; this can be repeated by selecting the "Blow" option in the Worn Equipment tab.

31283.title: Soup
31283.intro: Soup is a skilling pet that can be obtained while training the Sailing skill.
acquisition: Soup is a skilling pet that can be obtained while training the Sailing skill.
If a player's inventory is full and they have a follower already, they will not receive the pet; it must instead be claimed from Probita in East Ardougne .

Soup can only be rolled when the player is performing a Sailing activity. No pet roll is given when a crewmate action results in earned experience (such as the crewmate salvaging or trimming sails). For shipwreck salvaging, the pet is rolled upon collecting the salvage, with a very small chance upon sorting. For port tasks, the pet rolls upon claiming the rewards of the task, with a drop chance scaling with the task level. The drop rate for port tasks is 1 in 6000 − 2850 98 ⋅ ( l v l − 1 ) . The player's Sailing level at the time of completion is not accounted for when rolling for the pet.

The fastest method on average to receive Soup is by rapidly completing courier tasks between Aldarin and the Sunset Coast for roughly a 1/4691. After every 8 courier tasks, the notice board will reset. Occasionally, upon reset, no tasks will be available between Aldarin and the Sunset Coast. When this occurs, players should complete 8 courier tasks between Port Sarim and The Pandemonium to quickly force another board reset and then return to Aldarin. Because of this, it can be useful to park a second boat at the Pandemonium docks, which can quickly be accessed via the Sailor's amulet , Charter ships or the Teleport to boat spell.

31989.title: Boat bottle
31989.intro: Boat bottles are a single-use item obtained rarely from sorting low-tier salvage from shipwrecks . It is used to "place" a player's boat into their inventory, allowing them to transport it to another port from land. This is useful for moving boats without a teleport focus built on them.
acquisition: Boat bottles are a single-use item obtained rarely from sorting low-tier salvage from shipwrecks . It is used to "place" a player's boat into their inventory, allowing them to transport it to another port from land. This is useful for moving boats without a teleport focus built on them.

Using the "Bottle-boat" option on an empty bottle requires an empty cargo hold, as well as being at a docking point . When using the "Unbottle-boat" option on a full bottle, players will receive a confirmation message before doing so. The bottle will be lost when the player releases the boat.

Compared with the cost of recovering a boat in order to move it to a different port, using a boat bottle on a raft will result in a profit/loss of −19,690 coins , with a skiff −15,815 coins , and with a sloop 30,060 coins .

31996.title: Dragon metal sheet
31996.intro: Dragon metal sheets are an item used in high-level shipbuilding , with some of the best facilities on a boat requiring multiple sheets to build.
acquisition: The best sources for these sheets are killing lava strykewyrms or frost dragons on task, however these can be quite tedious to obtain, especially if the player does not have enough slayer points to skip for them. A slower but more consistent method is completing bounty tasks for great white sharks , orcas , and high-levelled krakens (preferably armoured krakens ), as one bounty task for each of these monsters are guaranteed at various notice boards across Gielinor.
Note: Drop rates are increased when killing frost dragons or lava strykewyrms on a slayer task, or the above sea creatures while completing a Sailing bounty .
Receiving a dragon metal sheet from a lost ironwood crate now adds it to the collection log .
The item was added to the game but unobtainable.

32398.title: Sailors' amulet
32398.intro: The sailors' amulet is an item that can be obtained as loot when sorting through salvage obtained from shipwreck salvaging . The amulet allows the player to teleport to the Pandemonium , Port Roberts , Red Rock , and Deepfin Point . In order to make use of the amulet's destinations, the player must activate their corresponding Sailors' Marker there.
acquisition: The sailors' amulet is an item that can be obtained as loot when sorting through salvage obtained from shipwreck salvaging . The amulet allows the player to teleport to the Pandemonium , Port Roberts , Red Rock , and Deepfin Point . In order to make use of the amulet's destinations, the player must activate their corresponding Sailors' Marker there.

The amulet consumes 90% less law runes, as it uses one charge per teleport and ten charges can be added by using one law rune and 10 water runes on the amulet, up to a maximum of 10,000 charges. This makes the cost of ten charges 173 coins and the cost of fully charging it 173,000 coins . The amulet cannot be uncharged . No experience points are granted when charging the amulet, and rune-saving equipment such as a staff of water cannot be used to decrease the rune cost.

The teleport to The Pandemonium is unlocked by default. To use the teleports to Port Roberts , Red Rock , and Deepfin Point , the player must first inspect the Sailors' Marker on their docks. The Red Rock teleport requires partial completion of the quest The Red Reef to land at the port and be able to inspect the Sailors' Marker.

33091.intro: The bottomless milk bucket is dropped by Brutus , the repeatable post-quest boss of The Ides of Milk quest. It can be used to hold up to 10,000 uses of a variety of milks and milk-related products, albeit one at a time:
acquisition: Unlike the bottomless compost bucket , the bottomless milk bucket is untradeable even when empty. Although the bottomless bucket has a risk value of 100,000, if you die with the bucket in the Wilderness beyond level 20, the player that kills you receives 5,400 coins.

33124.title: Beef

When this occurs, the message in the chatbox will instead state You feel something weird sneaking into your
acquisition: Beef is a pet that can be obtained from defeating Brutus .

acquisition: Extra sheets of pristine spider silk can be given to Brother Aimeri in exchange for a grubby key . This requires starting the miniquest In Search of Knowledge , by healing him with five pieces of food (must be meat, fish, or vegetables).

Players can receive the schematic by speaking to Ava in Draynor Manor after completing Animal Magnetism and Pandemonium . Even though the ballistic attractor requires 50 Sailing to build, there is no Sailing level requirement to claim the schematic.

33382.title: Immaculate mole skin
33382.intro: Immaculate mole skins are a tertiary drop from the Giant Mole , which are used to combine the gem bag and gem tote to create the gem sack . Doing so requires a needle and level 81 Crafting , granting 300 experience.
acquisition: Extra immaculate mole skins can be exchanged with Wyson the gardener for five bird nests .

33423.title: Bosun's workbench schematic
33423.intro: Bosun's workbench schematic is a lost schematic and a quest reward from The Red Reef . Reading it permanently unlocks the ability to construct Bosun's workbench , a facility on players' boats that allows crewmates to automatically make repairs.
acquisition: Bosun's workbench schematic is a lost schematic and a quest reward from The Red Reef . Reading it permanently unlocks the ability to construct Bosun's workbench , a facility on players' boats that allows crewmates to automatically make repairs.

33631.title: Crimson kisten
33631.intro: The crimson kisten is a two-handed spiked weapon requiring level 60 Attack and 85 Strength to wield. Obtained as a rare drop from the Maggot King , the weapon is mainly used for its special attack , dealing high damage against opponents weak to crush attacks.
acquisition: The crimson kisten is a two-handed spiked weapon requiring level 60 Attack and 85 Strength to wield. Obtained as a rare drop from the Maggot King , the weapon is mainly used for its special attack , dealing high damage against opponents weak to crush attacks.

33634.title: Elder venator fang
33634.intro: The elder venator fang is an item dropped by the Maggot King . With a Crafting level of 84, it can be etched using a chisel to produce the tradeable etched elder venator fang , which is used to upgrade the necklace of anguish into the necklace of rupture , giving 500 Crafting experience. The etched elder venator fang , despite being tradeable, cannot be sacrificed in Death's Coffer .

33642.title: Maggot marquess
33642.intro: Maggot marquess is a pet that can be obtained from defeating the Maggot King , being a much smaller version of it.
acquisition: Maggot marquess is a pet that can be obtained from defeating the Maggot King , being a much smaller version of it.
If a player's inventory is full and they have a follower already, they will not receive the pet; it must instead be claimed from Probita in East Ardougne .

When interacting with the Maggot King Corpse , players can choose to open its stomach or take eggs from it. Taking the "Open-stomach" option rolls the drop table as normal, including a 1/3,500 chance to receive the pet as a tertiary drop .

Meanwhile, choosing the "Take-eggs" option may reward the player with one of six types of maggot eggs , each of which have their own rates for the pet. Choosing this option forfeits all other potential loot, unless a supply drop is rolled from the maggot egg table.

33661.title: Venator fang
33661.intro: Venator fangs are an item dropped by venators and the Maggot King . These can be traded in for dragon arrowtips at a 1:1 ratio by speaking to the aranei by the aranei shrines in the Apsul or Virer Hunting Grounds , or by choosing their right-click "Trade-teeth" option.

33663.title: Venator tooth
33663.intro: Venator teeth are an item dropped by venators and the Maggot King . These can be traded in for dragon dart tips at a 1:1 ratio by speaking to the aranei by the aranei shrines in the Apsul or Virer Hunting Grounds , or by choosing their right-click "Trade-teeth" option.

34024.title: Jeweller's chisel
34024.intro: The jeweller's chisel is a reward from golem crafting on the island of Wyrmscraig . It is an improved version of the chisel with passive effects when cutting gems .
acquisition: The jeweller's chisel is a reward from golem crafting on the island of Wyrmscraig . It is an improved version of the chisel with passive effects when cutting gems .
It is obtained as a rare drop after inserting a sunstone core into an unpowered golem whilst golem crafting .

34027.title: Hallowfell
34027.intro: Hallowfell is a two-handed sword that requires level 75 Attack to wield. It is a reward from fighting the Mad Angel , a boss found on Wyrmscraig , and it has a unique effect where it can hit multiple enemies in an area around the player at once.
acquisition: Hallowfell is a two-handed sword that requires level 75 Attack to wield. It is a reward from fighting the Mad Angel , a boss found on Wyrmscraig , and it has a unique effect where it can hit multiple enemies in an area around the player at once.

34030.title: Jar of Light
34030.intro: The jar of light is a rare drop from the Mad Angel found on Wyrmscraig .

34033.title: Ardeaglais teleport
34033.intro: Ardeaglais teleport scrolls are consumable teleport scrolls that teleport the player to the entrance of Ardeaglais on Wyrmscraig . It is dropped by the Mad Angel , and can be stored in the master scroll book .

34040.title: Mr McGroot
34040.intro: Mr McGroot is a pet obtained from hunting goats on Wyrmscraig , a Hunter training method.
acquisition: Mr McGroot is a pet obtained from hunting goats on Wyrmscraig , a Hunter training method.
If a player's inventory is full and they have a follower already, they will not receive the pet; it must instead be claimed from Probita in East Ardougne .
A player's actual chances of receiving it is 1 B − ( L v l * 25 ) , where B is the base chance and L v l is the player's Hunter level.
Similar to other pets obtained via skilling, the drop rate increases by 15 times when the player reaches 200 million experience in Hunter, putting the rate at ~1/2501.

34042.title: Aggy
34042.intro: Aggy is a pet that can be obtained from defeating the Mad Angel , being a much smaller version of it.
acquisition: Aggy is a pet that can be obtained from defeating the Mad Angel , being a much smaller version of it.

34401.title: Necklace of Fangs
34401.intro: The necklace of fangs is a piece of combat jewellery that gives combat bonuses to Ranged . It is dropped from turoths and spiked turoths .
acquisition: It offers higher offensive ranged bonuses than the amulet of glory and amulet of fury , though lower than the necklace of anguish , serving as an intermediate upgrade for players who have not yet obtained a necklace of anguish. Unlike those amulets however, it does not possess any defensive or prayer bonuses.

34404.title: Air diamond
34404.intro: The air diamond is an elemental gem obtained by killing killerwatts . It is used in the creation of the amulet of air , the air diamond must be used on the Air Altar along with an amulet of magic and 100 air runes .
acquisition: The air diamond is an elemental gem obtained by killing killerwatts . It is used in the creation of the amulet of air , the air diamond must be used on the Air Altar along with an amulet of magic and 100 air runes .

34410.title: Water sapphire

acquisition: The water sapphire is an elemental gem obtained by killing sea snakes in the Miscellania and Etceteria dungeon . It is used in the creation of the amulet of water , the water sapphire must be used on the Water Altar along with an amulet of magic and 100 water runes .

34416.title: Earth emerald
